title: Hausdorff measure scaling under the blow-up map
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, x ∈ ℝ^P, r ∈ ℝ with r > 0, and S ⊆ ℝ^P an arbitrary (not necessarily measurable) set. Let η_{x,r}(y) := r⁻¹(y − x) (SimonGMT blowUpMap x r) and Hⁿ := μHE[n] (Mathlib's normalized n-dimensional Euclidean Hausdorff measure). Then Hⁿ(η_{x,r}(S)) = r^{−n}·Hⁿ(S) in [0, ∞], the factor r^{−n} being written ENNReal.ofReal (r⁻¹ ^ n).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (x : Euclid P) (r : ℝ) (S : Set (Euclid P)), 0 < r → μHE[n] (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' S) = ENNReal.ofReal (r⁻¹ ^ n) * μHE[n] S
